## Berlin Workshop Venue Fit for 40 People on 2026-04-15
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

For a 1-day workshop in Berlin, the best venue is usually a flexible meeting room, training space, or coworking event room that can cover the full day within **€1,500 total**. Prioritize accessibility and AV first, then compare room hire, catering policy, and setup flexibility.

## Venue-Selection Framework and Quote Request Targets
| Criterion | What to look for | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| Capacity | Comfortably seats 40 in workshop layout, with spare room for movement | High |
| AV | Projector included, reliable screen, HDMI/USB-C support | High |
| Collaboration | Whiteboard or flipchart available, extra markers | High |
| Accessibility | Step-free entry, elevator, accessible restroom | High |
| Light | Natural light preferred, blinds for projection control | Medium |
| Lunch space | Separate catering area or breakout space for lunch | High |
| Cost | Room hire + VAT + cleaning + AV + catering minimums within budget | High |
| Location | Easy transit access in Berlin, ideally near U/S-Bahn | Medium |

### Budget Split That Usually Works
- **Room hire:** €900–€1,200
- **AV / whiteboard:** €0–€150 if included, more if rented separately
- **Catering space / setup fee:** €0–€150
- **Lunch catering:** €10–€20 per person if light lunch, or self-catered to stay on budget
- **Buffer:** €100–€200 for VAT or incidental charges

### Shortlist Logic for 3 Venues
Pick 3 venues that differ by price and style:
- **Venue A: Coworking/event room** — often best value, modern AV, good light
- **Venue B: Hotel meeting room** — dependable service, easier catering, sometimes higher cost
- **Venue C: Cultural / training space** — flexible layout, can be budget-friendly, check accessibility carefully

### Quote Comparison Sheet
| Venue | Estimated Fit | Likely Cost Risk | Best For | Watch-outs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Venue A | Strong | Low to medium | Budget control and modern setup | Catering minimums, room turnover time |
| Venue B | Strong | Medium to high | Smooth service and full-day support | Room hire may exceed budget |
| Venue C | Good | Low to medium | Flexible workshop atmosphere | Accessibility and AV confirmation |

## Quote Email Template for 3 Berlin Venues
Subject: Quote request for workshop venue in Berlin on 15 April 2026

Hello [Venue Name] team,

I’m organizing a **1-day workshop for 40 participants** in Berlin on **15 April 2026**, from **09:00 to 17:00**. I’d like to request a quote and confirm availability for the following requirements:

- Projector and screen
- Whiteboard or flipchart
- Natural light
- Wheelchair access
- Space for lunch catering or a nearby breakout area

Please include in your reply:
- Room hire price for the full day
- VAT and any service or cleaning fees
- AV equipment costs, if separate
- Catering options and minimum spend, if any
- Accessibility details
- Setup and teardown times
- Cancellation terms

If available, please also send:
- Floor plan or room layout options
- Photos of the room
- Wi-Fi details
- Any package pricing for room + lunch

Thank you, and I look forward to your quote.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Company / Organization]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

### Venue Quote Follow-Up Checklist
- Confirm exact room size and workshop layout for 40 people
- Ask whether lunch can be served on-site or in a nearby catering space
- Verify wheelchair access from street to room and restroom access
- Check whether projector, screen, and whiteboard are included
- Ask for the final all-in price before VAT surprises
